text: Assumption: The using application shall terminate ongoing diagnostic operations and ensure external synchronization prior to destruction — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: The using application shall terminate ongoing diagnostic operations and ensure external synchronization prior to destruction — is this correct?
norm: the using application shall terminate ongoing diagnostic operations and ensure external synchronization prior to destruction
assumption: The using application shall terminate ongoing diagnostic operations and ensure external synchronization prior to destruction.
rationale: The specification designates the method as not thread-safe, but offers no internal synchronization mechanisms for the time of destruction.

original.text: Annahme: Die anwendende Applikation muss vor dem Zerstören laufende Diagnosevorgänge beenden und externe Synchronisation gewährleisten — trifft das zu?
